title: Invertibility of the specified derived open restriction mate
statement: Let ell be prime, k a field of positive characteristic different from ell, and Lambda an admissible condensed coefficient. Let r:W\to Y be a morphism and i:V\to Y a quasi-compact open immersion of separated finite-type k-schemes. For every object B of the unbounded derived category of condensed Lambda-modules on W, the canonical pullback-compositor/direct-image-counit mate mateOpenProperRestriction in the Cartesian square is invertible. No properness of r or constructibility of B is required. Notions and canonical constructions: [sk-def-localizing-closure], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [def-sfb-mate-open-restriction-maps].

source.place: Proof (2), open restriction commutes with derived direct image

proof.text: Use the normalized underived open-square scalar comparison to identify the inverse mate of the inverse-image compositor with the open-extension comparison. Its normalization is expressed by the open units.

Descend the unit equation termwise to derived categories. The iterated-mates identity identifies the direct-image restriction mate with the conjugate of this invertible comparison under the two composite adjunctions; hence it is invertible.

The private generic mate_component lemma expands the unit formula for the adjunction Hom equivalence and functoriality. It identifies this mate component with mateOpenProperRestriction. The canonical and total-derived adjunctions agree after the recorded inverse-image isomorphism.

theorem mateOpenProperRestriction_isIso
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    {W V Y : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType W.hom] [QuasiCompact W.hom] [IsSeparated W.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [QuasiCompact V.hom] [IsSeparated V.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    (r : W ⟶ Y) (i : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i.left] [QuasiCompact i.left]
    (B : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology W.left) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ W.left))) :
    IsIso (mateOpenProperRestriction Λ
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback r.left i.left).toCommSq B)
